description: This file defines a configuration class for OpenAI image generation using GPT models, including methods for supported parameters, mapping parameters, and transforming responses.

classes.name: GPTImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI GPT-based image generation, extending BaseImageGenerationConfig.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI image generation parameters for a given model.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters into optional parameters, validating support and optionally dropping unsupported ones.

methods.name: transform_image_generation_response
methods.description: Transforms raw HTTP response into an ImageResponse object, with logging and optional parameter settings.
